positions.as_written: Assess the meniscus in both planes and establish how many distinct tear planes are present.
Identify whether any component reaches the capsular margin, since a complete radial component changes the mechanics.
Measure extrusion, which in this setting is more informative than the tear description.
Assess the cartilage and the bone in the compartment, because they are the reason this meniscus looks like this.
